title: Kuzungumza ili Kupasha Habari (Theme 8: Ulaguzi wa binadamu)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 7 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child plans what to say, listens to the end, and replies on the topic in standard Kiswahili with the features of a kupasha.
steps: Reply on the topic with a reason.
Keep the language and the turn-taking right.

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child takes part in a short kupasha on the topic while a partner ticks the checklist.

misconceptions.repair: Habari kamili hujibu nani, nini, lini na wapi.

misconceptions.ask: Hili ni jambo la kweli au maoni yako?
misconceptions.repair: Unapopasha habari, toa ukweli bila maoni yako.

misconceptions.ask: Ni maneno yapi si ya Kiswahili sanifu?
misconceptions.repair: Tumia Kiswahili sanifu katika mazungumzo rasmi.

checks.question: Unapasha habari ya mkutano. Ni ipi kamili?
checks.answer: Kutakuwa na mkutano wa wazazi Jumamosi saa nne asubuhi ukumbini.

checks.question: Ni sentensi ipi ni habari tu?
